title.narrative: EU support to a better disaster risks system in the cross border area - Joint Response

description.narrative: The project plans to improve the integration of the system of prevention, intervention, and recovery process from disasters caused by climate change in the cross-border area. To achieve this, the project will improve the capacity for cross-border cooperation and the cross-border system for interventions during and recovery after a disaster.
